note: ORPHAN Pro 5:20 — why be intoxicated, my son, with a forbidden woman?

dims.v: infatuation — being led astray, drunk with a forbidden woman
the being intoxicated/led astray with a forbidden woman — the infatuation that reels like drunkenness, reason drowned in illicit desire, staggering after the adulteress
the lust-drunkenness that reels a man off the straight path

shagah (go astray / be intoxicated) — 'why should you be INTOXICATED, my son, with a forbidden woman?' (5:20); illicit desire is a drunkenness that makes a man stagger and stray. Infatuation drowns the judgement as wine drowns the wits (cf 5:19; 20:1).
